name: Aki
source:
[i]The[/i] protagonist of the game who tries to save herself from misfortunes.

At first, she tolerates and ignores them because [i]"strong people don't give up in the face of difficulties"[/i]. 

Aki is an open-minded, cheerful and kind girl. She's the kind of person who will always come to the rescue with a smile on her face and fight to the end, though sometimes she can feel really conflicted.

She is active and loves movement, so the endless stay at home may slowly drive her crazy. 

She loves beautiful hairstyles and often asks her mom to make her hair. She tried to braid her hair her-self, and practiced it on her dad. He wasn't impressed.

[i]"The best thing to do right now is to retreat. No good deed goes unpunished."[/i]

[Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753200]official art-book[/url]]
